مَآءٌ فَاتِرٌ , (T, M, O, K,) and ↓ فَاتُورٌ , (M, K,) Water between hot and cold; lukewarm; tepid; (T, O;) water ceasing to be hot. (M, K.) ―
-b2- طَرْفٌ فَاتِرٌ (assumed tropical:) An eye, or eyes, in which is a weakness that is deemed beautiful; (B, TA;) [i. e., languishing,] in which is languish, or languidness; (T;) not having a sharp look: (T, M, K;) or not sharp. (S, O.) [See 4.] ―
-b3- مَشْىٌ فَاتِرٌ A weak walking. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
